comment: Map engine rules (US-4.1 to 4.4; the C# port of the shipped engine/mapgen.js, model/floorplan.js, engine/actmap.js and the Unknown-node roll). The retry and guard counts and the closed vocabularies the shipped code kept as constants live here as data. Changing any of them changes every seeded map; the parity oracle pins the shipped values.

routes.comment: The Core 2 route builder's closed names (web engine/actmap.js buildGameProfileActMap at b8cfe4fac). roles: the route types it treats by role. displayTypes: the map node type each authored route type is shown as. resolvedKinds: the kind a pre-resolved node reports when it differs from its type. unknownWeights: the odds it rolls its event nodes with (one weight, so the draw is taken and the result is always an event). lanes: the branchColumns it accepts. laneCentre: where a node shared by every lane sits across the lane span.
